Markets.title: Tempsens Instruments IPO opens today: GMP at 73%. Check key details and should you subscribe?
Markets.summary: Tempsens Instruments has opened its Rs 650 crore IPO, which remains available for subscription until August 24, 2026. The offering consists of a Rs 95 crore fresh issue and a Rs 555 crore offer for sale, with a current grey market premium of 73%.

Markets.title: Bonus issue alert! Last day to buy Goodluck India shares for 2:1 bonus reward. How will dividend payout be impacted?
Markets.summary: Goodluck India announced a 2:1 bonus issue, meaning shareholders will receive two new shares for every one share held. Today is the last day to buy the company's shares to be eligible for this bonus reward.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | Nifty enters ‘very attractive’ zone as earnings improve: Union AMC’s Sanjay Bembalkar
Markets.summary: Despite weak foreign investment and geopolitical tensions, corporate earnings remain encouraging and manufacturing segments show potential for stronger growth. According to Union AMC's Sanjay Bembalkar, these improving earnings have pushed the Nifty into a very attractive valuation zone.

Markets.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy LIC Housing Finance, Hitachi Energy among 38 stocks for dividends. How many do you own?
Markets.summary: Today is the final day to purchase shares of LIC Housing Finance, Hitachi Energy, and 36 other stocks to qualify for their upcoming dividends. Investors must buy these shares today so they are credited to their demat accounts by the August 21 record date under the T+1 settlement cycle.

Markets.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: GIFT Nifty signals a positive start; Asian shares trade higher
Markets.summary: Indian stock market indices are expected to open higher today, following positive cues from GIFT Nifty and Asian markets. Asian shares are currently trading in positive territory as well.

Markets.title: Negative Breakout: These 8 stocks cross below their 200 DMAs
Markets.summary: Eight stocks have triggered a negative breakout by falling below their 200-day moving averages. Traders closely watch this specific indicator to determine a stock's overall market trend.

Geo-Political.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli military confirmed its soldiers fired at the car carrying five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab and opened a criminal investigation. Rajab initially survived the attack and pleaded for help, but her body was later found alongside those of six of her relatives.

Geo-Political.title: Australia 'outraged' after Israeli decision not to prosecute over killing of aid worker in Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: Australia's foreign minister expressed outrage and will summon the Israeli ambassador following Israel's decision not to prosecute anyone over the killing of aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza. Frankcom was killed alongside six other World Central Kitchen aid workers in an Israeli airstrike in April 2024.

Geo-Political.title: Trump threatens 'tremendous economic consequences' on any country helping Iran
Geo-Political.summary: Following the expiration of a 60-day ceasefire without a diplomatic resolution, Donald Trump threatened severe economic consequences for any nation assisting Iran. This warning escalates tensions as the ongoing conflict between the involved parties continues without a visible off-ramp.

Geo-Political.title: Giant whales move into Greenland waters as ice disappears
Geo-Political.summary: Melting sea ice driven by climate change has opened up Greenland's waters to giant whales. These whales are now moving into the region to engage in extensive feeding frenzies.

Geo-Political.title: Israel opens up bids for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project
Geo-Political.summary: Israel has opened bidding for a highly sensitive settlement project in the West Bank. The United Kingdom's foreign secretary condemned the decision as an unacceptable and destructive act.

Geo-Political.title: Ecuador intelligence chief and five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash
Geo-Political.summary: Ecuadorian intelligence chief Michele Sensi-Contugi, his wife Stephany Hollihan, and five Americans were killed in a helicopter crash in Kenya. A total of seven people died in the accident.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. The currency's actual impact depends on whether these capital inflows enter the market or are absorbed by the central bank as reserves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank requires more clarity on persistently high prices before taking action. The Monetary Policy Committee minutes indicate that future interest rates may rise if inflation continues.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — Unpacking the economics of India's toll landscape, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highways Management Company Limited (IHMCL) reveals how high-traffic routes, changing private sector involvement, and FASTag annual passes shape India's highway revenue. These factors collectively drive the economic model behind the country's toll collection system.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that ongoing conflicts in West Asia, high inflation, currency depreciation, and sluggish capital expenditure continue to pose downside risks.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes. This strategy aims to counteract the negative economic impacts of El Nino and a weak monsoon on the rural economy.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research predicts India will achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus for fiscal year 2027. This projected surplus is driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

India.title: NCERT Forms New Political Science Textbook Team; 4 Members Linked To RSS
India.summary: NCERT has reconstituted its Class 11 and 12 political science textbook development team to incorporate cultural rootedness and Indian knowledge systems. Four of the newly appointed members have links to the RSS.

India.title: Bandi Sanjay Announces Free Power For Telangana's Karimnagar Ganesh Pandals
India.summary: Karimnagar MP Bandi Sanjay Kumar announced free electricity for Ganesh pandals in Karimnagar. The initiative is intended to encourage young people to participate in devotional and community activities.

India.title: Should India Keep UPI Free For Consumers? Ex-Payments Body Board Member Explains
India.summary: Former NPCI director Santanu Paul stated that UPI's remarkable success is directly linked to its free-to-use model for consumers. He argued against changing this structure, explaining that keeping the service free is essential for maintaining its widespread adoption in India.

India.title: Congress Firm On 2-Stanza Vande Mataram, BJP Terms Party "Muslim League"
India.summary: The Congress Working Committee decided to stick to its 1937 resolution restricting party events to only the first two stanzas of Vande Mataram. In response, the BJP criticized the decision by labeling the Congress party as the "Muslim League."

India.title: Tourists Thrashed, Harassed For 2 Hours Over 8-Year-Old's Shorts At Pune Fort
India.summary: Pune police registered a case against nine people for assaulting and harassing tourists for two hours at Sinhagad Fort on August 16. The attack was reportedly triggered by an eight-year-old child's choice of clothing.

India.title: Fake, Expired Medicines Worth Rs 5 Crore Seized Repacking Unit In Bengaluru
India.summary: Bengaluru authorities seized fake and expired medicines worth Rs 5 crore from a repacking unit. The operators bought cheap drugs from other states, put them in new vials, and relabeled them as expensive multinational and imported brands.

General.title: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are moving back to the UK with their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet. The children are enrolled to start school there in September.

General.title: Harry and Meghan are experts in surprise - but is their UK return forever?
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have made a sudden return to the UK. This unexpected visit raises questions about the future of their relationship with the Royal Family.

General.title: Vaccine breakthrough stops cancer returning in trial
General.summary: A new vaccine trial successfully extended the period of time that patients remained cancer-free. However, researchers are currently unsure about the long-term duration of these protective effects.

General.title: People smuggler exposed by BBC investigation arrested and charged
General.summary: Twana Jamal Khdir, a people smuggler exposed by a BBC investigation, has been arrested. He has been charged with immigration offences.
